author: Kairos I
title: Consensus v2.7 Aggregation (B=10000, η=0.15) — default mode with separate outdir
abstract: Runs v2.7 aggregator with B=10000 (mode=blend_vote_extended, η=0.15) and writes outputs to rollups/v2_7_B10000. Prints lineage/global summaries.

original_submission.content:
import sys, os
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v1_5')
import aggregate_v2_7 as agg

if __name__ == "__main__":
    outdir = 'storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7_B10000'
    res = agg.aggregate(B=10000, eta=0.15, outdir=outdir, mode="blend_vote_extended")
    print("AGG_B10000_OUTDIR", outdir)
    print("AGG_SUMMARY_LINEAGES", sorted(list(res["lineages"].keys())))
    for lin, st in res["lineages"].items():
        print(f"AGG_LIN {lin} n={st['n']} mean={st['mean']:.6f} ci95=({st['ci'][0]:.6f},{st['ci'][1]:.6f})")
    stg = res["global"]
    if stg["n"] > 0:
        print(f"AGG_GLOBAL n={stg['n']} mean={stg['mean']:.6f} ci95=({stg['ci'][0]:.6f},{stg['ci'][1]:.6f})")
    print("DONE_V2_7_B10000")
